Create an ultra-realistic, high-end cinematic fantasy fashion photograph in a STRICT 9:16 VERTICAL composition, closely recreating the provided reference image in overall composition, camera perspective, framing, subject placement, pose, proportions, environment, lighting, atmosphere, color grading, reflections, fire effects, smoke, and cinematic mood.

REFERENCE IMAGE:
Use the provided reference image as the PRIMARY visual reference for the complete scene. Match the visual composition and photographic appearance as closely as possible.

MAIN CHARACTER — IDENTITY LOCK:
If a character/person reference image is provided, use that exact person as the main character.
Preserve the original facial identity, face shape, jawline, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, hairstyle, hair texture, skin tone, facial proportions and recognizable features exactly.
Do not redesign the face.
Do not beautify or alter the facial structure.
Do not change the person's identity.

POSE & COMPOSITION:
A young man is walking directly toward the camera in the exact center of a cracked, abandoned-looking asphalt road.
Full-body composition from head to boots.
The camera is positioned low and slightly below chest level, creating a powerful cinematic perspective.
The character is captured mid-stride, with one leg moving forward and the other behind.
His body is upright and confident, shoulders relaxed, arms naturally hanging while walking.
His facial expression is serious, calm, mysterious and emotionally controlled.
He is looking slightly toward the side rather than directly into the camera.

CLOTHING:
The character wears an elegant all-black luxury outfit.
Black tailored blazer with a slightly open front.
Underneath is a black shirt with several upper buttons naturally open, revealing a small portion of the chest.
Black fitted trousers.
Black leather combat-style ankle boots with realistic leather texture, laces and subtle highlights.
Add minimal layered silver/metallic necklaces around the neck.
The clothing must look premium, realistic and naturally fitted to the body.
Visible fabric texture, realistic folds, stitching and subtle reflections.

GUITAR:
The character holds and drags a black electric guitar beside him with one hand.
The guitar is positioned diagonally toward the lower-left side of the frame.
It is a glossy black electric guitar with a realistic polished body, dark fretboard, strings, pickups, bridge and metallic hardware.
The guitar is touching the road and appears to be dragging along the asphalt.
A trail of fire surrounds the lower part of the guitar and extends behind it.
The guitar must remain clearly visible and anatomically connected to the character's hand.

FIRE EFFECT:
Intense realistic orange and golden flames surround the character from behind, creating a dramatic fiery halo.
Flames rise around his shoulders, arms, sides, legs and lower body without obscuring his face.
The fire should look physically realistic with detailed flame tongues, glowing embers, sparks and subtle smoke.
Bright orange core flames transitioning into yellow and darker orange edges.
Small burning embers and glowing particles float naturally through the air.
Firelight creates realistic warm reflections on the character's black clothing, boots, guitar and wet road.

ROAD:
A long cracked asphalt road stretches into the background.
The road is wet and reflective, with puddles and irregular water patches.
Large natural cracks are visible in the foreground asphalt.
The orange fire reflects strongly inside the wet puddles and cracks.
Road texture must be extremely realistic with small stones, rough asphalt, water reflections and subtle mud.

BLACK ROSES:
Both sides of the road are lined with dramatic dark/black roses.
The roses appear slightly wilted and mysterious.
Some roses are surrounded by small flames.
The flowers should have detailed petals, stems and leaves.
They create a dark fantasy atmosphere while framing the central character.

BACKGROUND:
Dense green forest on both sides of the road.
Tall trees with realistic leaves and branches.
Deep forest perspective extending into the distance.
A massive dark black-gray smoke cloud rises behind the character.
The smoke should be thick, volumetric and dramatic, spreading across the upper-middle background.
The smoke partially covers the sky but does not completely hide the trees.
Small orange embers are floating in front of the smoke.

SKY & WEATHER:
Overcast stormy sky with pale gray-blue light.
Dark atmospheric clouds mixed with thick black smoke.
Soft diffused daylight coming from above and behind the clouds.
No bright sunny sky.
The overall environment should feel dark, mysterious, apocalyptic and cinematic.

LIGHTING:
Strong cinematic contrast between cool natural ambient daylight and warm orange firelight.
Warm firelight illuminates the character's edges and clothing from behind.
Create realistic rim lighting around the hair, shoulders, blazer and legs.
Subtle cool fill light on the face.
Natural skin highlights.
Realistic shadows beneath the character and guitar.
Volumetric smoke lighting and atmospheric depth.

CAMERA:
Professional cinematic full-frame camera.
Low-angle perspective.
35mm cinematic lens.
Moderate shallow depth of field.
Main character extremely sharp and detailed.
Background gradually falls into realistic atmospheric depth.
Natural perspective without extreme wide-angle distortion.
Photorealistic optical characteristics.
Subtle cinematic lens bloom around the brightest flames.

IMAGE QUALITY:
Ultra-photorealistic.
High dynamic range.
Extremely detailed skin texture.
Realistic individual hair strands.
Realistic fabric texture.
Realistic leather texture.
Highly detailed guitar.
Physically accurate fire and smoke.
Natural reflections on wet asphalt.
Professional cinematic color grading.
Sharp subject separation.
Subtle film grain.
Premium movie-poster photography quality.
No cartoon appearance.
No CGI-looking character.
No plastic skin.

FRAMING:
STRICT 9:16 VERTICAL.
Character centered in the frame.
Head positioned around the upper-middle portion.
Full body clearly visible.
Large amount of cracked wet road visible in the foreground.
Fire reflections visible prominently in the lower portion.
Forest framing both sides.
Smoke cloud dominating the upper background.
Maintain the same visual hierarchy as the reference.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
low quality, blurry face, distorted face, changed identity, different person, extra fingers, missing fingers, deformed hands, bad anatomy, extra limbs, duplicate body, duplicate guitar, floating guitar, distorted guitar, cartoon, anime, illustration, CGI look, plastic skin, oversaturated colors, unrealistic fire, fake smoke, flat lighting, incorrect proportions, wide-angle distortion, cropped feet, cropped head, incomplete body, duplicate flowers, text, logo, watermark, captions, artificial facial features, deformed eyes, asymmetrical face, blurry details.

FINAL RESULT:
A highly realistic cinematic dark-fantasy photograph of the reference character confidently walking down a wet cracked forest road while dragging a burning black electric guitar, surrounded by flames, black roses, floating embers and enormous dark smoke clouds, with dramatic warm firelight contrasting against the cool stormy environment. The final image must look like a professionally photographed high-budget cinematic scene, not an AI-generated image.

title: Cinematic sky after rain

prompt:
Use the uploaded image as the ONLY identity reference. Identity preservation has absolute highest priority over artistic style, clothing, pose, lighting, or environment. Preserve 100% of the facial identity, facial proportions, jawline, cheekbones, forehead, eyebrows, eye shape and spacing, eyelashes, nose shape, lips, beard, mustache, ears, hairstyle, hairline, hair density, hair direction, hair volume, skin tone, natural skin texture, pores, blemishes, acne marks, facial hair pattern, and every unique facial detail exactly as shown. Create an ultra-photorealistic vertical 4:5 environmental portrait that looks like a genuine documentary photograph captured naturally by a professional street photographer, not an AI-generated artwork or fashion photoshoot. The camera is positioned 6–8 meters away using a natural telephoto perspective so the subject occupies only 35–40% of the frame, allowing the environment to tell the story. The camera views the subject from a gentle front-left three-quarter angle at eye level, maintaining natural human proportions with no wide-angle distortion or close-up framing.
The subject is walking slowly across a clean, modern Japanese pedestrian bridge overlooking a long, empty city road during a gentle mid-rain at blue hour. Both hands remain naturally inside the pockets of the trousers. The shoulders are slightly lowered with relaxed posture. The head is slightly lowered toward the wet road ahead, not looking upward. The face naturally angles downward while remaining about 70–80% visible to the camera. The eyes are focused quietly on the rain-soaked road rather than the camera. The expression is subtle, emotionally exhausted, deeply reflective, quietly heartbroken, and accepting, with no tears, no exaggerated sadness, and no theatrical posing.
The subject wears a minimalist Japanese-inspired oversized black open button-up shirt made from premium lightweight wrinkle-resistant Japanese woven cotton with a soft matte finish and natural drape. The shirt is only slightly oversized, never bulky or puffy, with every button left open to reveal a clean fitted white crew-neck T-shirt underneath. A slim black necktie hangs loosely and naturally, gently moved by the rain and breeze. The subject wears tailored Japanese formal pleated trousers (office-style slacks) crafted from lightweight wrinkle-resistant Japanese suiting fabric with elegant front pleats, a clean straight-leg silhouette, realistic folds, and authentic fabric movement. The shoes are simple black leather loafers with subtle rainwater and realistic everyday wear.
The cool rainy evening naturally softens the warmth of the complexion while preserving the original skin tone from the uploaded image. The cheeks and the tip of the nose carry only a faint natural pink tint from the cold air. The face shows realistic pores, tiny imperfections, subtle dampness from fine rain mist, authentic lip texture, and the subject's original beard pattern without increasing its density. The hairstyle remains identical to the uploaded image, only lightly dampened by the rain with a few natural strands separating under gravity. Tiny water droplets cling realistically to the eyebrows and eyelashes. The skin appears naturally hydrated by the rain without becoming oily, waxy, or overly smooth.
The bridge overlooks a long, empty road after rainfall. The center of the asphalt has begun drying into a soft charcoal-gray strip while the edges remain deep black with rainwater. Narrow streams of water flow beside the curbs carrying scattered yellow leaves, tiny twigs, and small patches of foam. Shallow puddles reflect overhead power lines, streetlights, trees, and the gray evening sky with realistic ripples from falling raindrops. Near a storm drain, a faint rainbow sheen from diluted motor oil appears naturally within the moving water. Modern steel guardrails are lined with heavy raindrops that occasionally fall. Wet roadside trees drip continuously while fresh rainwater darkens their bark. The road stretches toward the horizon where soft rain and atmospheric moisture gently blur the distance. Beyond the bridge, a calm Japanese city glows with subtle building lights and distant vehicle headlights reflected softly on the wet asphalt.
The sky consists of layered storm clouds with occasional cool blue openings. Fine diagonal silver streaks of rain remain visible where illuminated by warm streetlights. Thin wisps of vapor rise naturally from sections of the still-warm road. The entire overcast sky acts as a giant natural diffuser, producing soft shadowless lighting with realistic contrast and lifelike skin tones. No HDR, no orange-and-teal grading, no fantasy lighting, no excessive bokeh, no dramatic fog, and no cinematic glow. The environment should feel exactly like a real Japanese city immediately after rainfall.
Captured using a Sony A7R V, 85mm prime lens, f/2.8, realistic exposure, authentic white balance, documentary photography style, subtle natural film grain, accurate dynamic range, lifelike colors, genuine fabric textures, realistic rain physics, and natural camera optics. The final image must be indistinguishable from a real DSLR photograph, with authentic human anatomy, realistic body proportions, natural clothing wrinkles, and absolutely no AI artifacts, no plastic skin, no altered hairstyle, no distorted anatomy, no exaggerated symmetry, no text, and no watermark. If any instruction conflicts, always preserve the exact identity, face, hair, and skin texture from the uploaded reference image.

Transform the person from the reference photo into a highly detailed hand-drawn graphite pencil portrait while preserving their recognizable identity.

Preserve the person's exact facial structure and recognizable characteristics:
facial proportions, eye shape, eyebrow shape, nose structure, cheekbones, jawline, forehead, hairline, natural facial asymmetry, age appearance, and all distinctive facial features.

Do not turn the person into a generic character.

The eyes, facial proportions, and overall bone structure must remain recognizably faithful to the reference photograph.

Do not beautify, idealize, feminize, masculinize, anime-ify, or redesign the person's face.

STYLE:
Create a traditional monochrome graphite pencil drawing on slightly textured white/off-white paper.

The artwork must look genuinely hand-drawn with graphite pencils, not digitally rendered.

Use strong black graphite in the darkest areas and lighter gray pencil strokes throughout the drawing.

Create extensive visible pencil hatching and cross-hatching.

Use hundreds of individual hand-drawn strokes rather than smooth digital gradients.

Allow slight irregularities, overlapping strokes, uneven pressure, stray pencil marks, and imperfect contours so the artwork feels physically drawn by an artist.

COMPOSITION:
Create an extremely tight close-up portrait focused primarily on the person's eyes and upper face.

The face fills almost the entire frame.

Crop the composition closely around the forehead, cheeks, nose, and lower face.

The eyes should be the strongest visual focal point.

Use a slightly angled three-quarter facial orientation if it naturally suits the person's reference, while preserving their actual facial structure.

The composition should feel intimate and dramatic, like a character-study sketch.

FACE:
Render the person's actual facial features using expressive graphite linework.

Use darker strokes around the eyelashes, eyebrows, hairline, eyelids, and strongest facial contours.

Use lighter construction lines for the forehead, nose bridge, cheeks, and surrounding facial planes.

Do not make the skin completely blank white.

Build subtle tonal variation using very fine graphite hatching.

Preserve realistic facial anatomy while keeping the medium unmistakably hand-drawn.

EYES:
The eyes are the primary focal point.

Render the exact eye shape and proportions from the identity reference.

Create highly detailed irises, pupils, eyelids, eyelashes, and subtle shadows beneath the eyes.

Use darker graphite around the upper eyelids and eyelashes.

Add small natural highlights within the eyes using untouched paper.

The eyes should feel expressive and alive despite the monochrome medium.

HAIR:
Preserve the person's natural hairstyle and hairline from the identity reference.

Render the hair using directional graphite strokes following the actual flow of the hair.

Use dense dark pencil shading in the deepest hair regions.

Individual strands should overlap and intersect naturally.

Avoid perfectly smooth digital hair.

Use loose stray pencil lines around the hair silhouette.

LOWER FACE / CLOTHING:
If the reference contains clothing, scarf, mask, collar, or another object around the lower face, preserve its general structure while translating it into expressive graphite strokes.

If generating the same visual concept as the supplied artwork, place a dark fabric face covering/scarf across the lower half of the face, covering the nose and mouth while leaving both eyes clearly visible.

The fabric should be rendered using extremely dense graphite hatching and overlapping directional strokes.

Create realistic folds and creases using curved pencil lines.

The lower face covering should be one of the darkest areas of the image, contrasting strongly with the lighter facial regions.

GRAPHITE TECHNIQUE:
Use multiple levels of pencil pressure:

very light construction lines,
light gray shading,
medium graphite tones,
dense dark hatching,
deep near-black graphite in selected areas.

Use cross-hatching in the shadows.

Use directional hatching that follows facial anatomy.

Use short broken strokes around the eyes and skin.

Use longer flowing strokes through the hair.

Use broad overlapping graphite strokes in the dark fabric.

Leave some construction marks visible.

Allow some lines to extend slightly beyond the intended contours.

Include subtle erased/highlighted areas where the paper shows through.

PAPER:
Slightly rough white drawing paper.

Visible subtle paper grain.

No colored paper.

No digital canvas texture.

The graphite should appear physically deposited onto the paper.

LIGHTING:
Translate the lighting of the identity reference into pencil values rather than realistic color.

Use strong tonal contrast.

Bright areas remain mostly white paper.

Midtones use soft gray graphite.

Deep shadows use dense black hatching.

Create dramatic directional shading around the eyes, nose, hair, and fabric.

COLOR:
STRICTLY monochrome.

Black graphite.
Dark gray.
Medium gray.
Light gray.
White paper.

No color whatsoever.

CAMERA / FRAMING:
Vertical portrait composition.

Extremely close crop.

Face fills approximately 85–95% of the image.

High-detail facial study.

No distant background.

No environmental scene.

The artwork should resemble a photographed page from a professional artist's sketchbook.

AUTHENTIC HAND-DRAWN QUALITY:
Make the drawing imperfect in a deliberate, natural way.

Visible graphite grain.
Visible pencil strokes.
Uneven line pressure.
Subtle smudging.
Tiny stray marks.
Overlapping hatching.
Small construction lines.
Natural eraser marks.
Slightly inconsistent contours.

Do NOT make every line mathematically perfect.

Do NOT use smooth digital gradients.

Do NOT make the image look like a vector illustration.

The final result should look as though a skilled portrait artist spent significant time drawing the person by hand with graphite pencils.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:

photorealistic photograph, color, digital painting, digital illustration, vector art, 3D render, CGI, anime, cartoon, smooth digital shading, airbrushed skin, plastic texture, perfect clean lines, flat black shapes, excessive blur, generic face, altered identity, different facial structure, changed eyes, changed nose, changed jawline, beautified face, unrealistic symmetry, distorted anatomy, oversimplified face, artificial hair, colored pencil, watercolor, oil paint, markers, neon, gradients, text, typography, logo, watermark.

IDENTITY PRIORITY:
The uploaded personal reference controls the person's identity, facial anatomy, proportions, hairstyle, and recognizable features.

The supplied style reference controls the graphite technique, close-up composition, monochrome palette, dramatic hatching, construction lines, and hand-drawn aesthetic.

Preserve the PERSON.
Recreate the ART STYLE.
